title: SSE UTF-8 split-chunk handling is genuinely correct and robust
description: The raw_buf + buf two-stage approach correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 codepoints split across HTTP stream chunks. The drain logic (drain valid prefix OR at least 1 byte to prevent stuck infinite loop) is non-obvious but correct. The scan_from optimization (rescan from old_len - 3) correctly avoids O(n^2) rescanning without missing delimiter splits. A future contributor might simplify by always rescanning from 0 (correct but slower) or by treating invalid UTF-8 as a fatal error (breaks against compliant SSE servers that use non-ASCII in event data). Both simplifications would be incorrect. This code should be defended.
